title: ContHarnessParameters
description: Typed parameter block of the Cont-type analysis harness. Shared by ContHarnessInput and echoed verbatim into ContHarnessOutput. Contains NO threshold and NO acceptance band: those are Week 3 preregistration material and a schema that admitted one here would let it be set by accident.

kind.description: What one interval counts. Fixed by the log's time_unit in the sense that a step-indexed log cannot be intervalled by wall time.

intervals.description: Intervals per window; one regression per window. At least 3, because the primary specification has an intercept and a two-parameter fit on two points is not an estimate.

time_unit.description: Restated here rather than only in the log header: an injection time without a unit is not a time.

sampling.description: Event-driven, not clock-driven. A clock-driven rule needs an interpolation rule between events, and this contract does not define one.
